sections.title: The three-document minimum
sections.html: You need exactly three artifacts before kickoff: a scope one-pager, a access checklist, and a decision log. Everything else is theater.
sections.self_prompt: Is your team already doing this?

sections.title: Where automation actually helps
sections.html: Automate the chase, not the conversation. Reminders, access requests, and status pings are robot work. Discovery questions are not.
